title: Mads Øvlisen PhD Scholarships within Art History and Practice-Based Artistic Research 2027
field: Art history; practice-based artistic and curatorial research

compensation.value: Up to DKK 3,080,000 per three-year grant
compensation.evidence_quote: a maximum of up to DKK 3.080.000 per grant

about: Five three-year Novo Nordisk Foundation PhD scholarships in art history and practice-based art research, for projects primarily in Denmark, up to DKK 3,080,000 each. The call opened 29 October 2026 and closes 14 January 2027 at 2:00pm Copenhagen time.
requirements: Completed master's degree or equivalent before applying
Practice-based applicants need a substantial, documented artistic or curatorial practice
Citizens of all countries may apply; the project must primarily take place in Denmark
PhD projects already initiated are not eligible

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "PhD Scholarships within Art History and Practice-Based Artistic Research" (three-year research project) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Completed master's degree or equivalent" (doctoral-level scholarly work) → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
